blocks.text: No small present is dismissed, and even the humblest offering is received, answered, or returned in generosity, which magnifies Banda’s fame among those approaching him.
The narrative then opens another stage of his career, showing wealth, expectation, and armed purpose gathering more heavily around him as people begin to read him as a force in the land.
This page uses the language of reception and redistribution to show that no offering is dismissed as too small once Banda’s public standing begins to expand.
